author: ExShot
body:
Currently there are two hackers on the server that are really obvious and no moderators online, or at least none that are doing things. First is Mman614 second is Snakeeye4242. Mman614 is using some hack that makes bows rapid fire and Snakeeye4242 is using a bunch of hacks. He is flying, turning invisible using reach and so on.

Please look further into this.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Hey Parso.

Please do not make forum reports on the forums just to warn mods that a hacker is online. We appreciate your support on trying to report these players but please do not post in the "report a player" section without proper evidence (such as video recording). Furthermore, you can contact a staff member via Teamspeak, skype, or the community slack (https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/a9121e12c) We appreciate your assistance but as stated before, try to contact mods some other way ;)

Regards,
ProfessorUtonium

(ps. We couldn't ban Mman614 as he left but we banned snakeye4242 for hacking :) )
